{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Compute conversion rate per customer_segment
# Conversion rate = mean of 'converted' in each segment
conversion_rate_by_segment = df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Print the full series to capture all values for evidence
print("Conversion rates by segment:")
print(conversion_rate_by_segment)

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
highest_segment = conversion_rate_by_segment.idxmax()

# Print the highest segment
print("\nSegment with highest conversion rate:")
print(highest_segment)

# Return for submission
conversion_rate_by_segment, highest_segment"}
